prior_credit: This is a credited complete consequence of earlier estimates. Scott's 2009 report of joint work with Tateno states the smaller all-integer modulus range, the necessary standard-deviation scale and a triangle Gaussian-cell local limit theorem. Gilmer and Kopparty's 2014 manuscript Lemmas 4-5 already imply the full sufficient range by direct modular Fourier-grid summation; the supporting deduction is assembled in the current audit and is not backdated as a printed 2014 corollary. Berkowitz supplies earlier quantitative triangle input. The main probability-mass proof imports Sah-Sawhney arXiv:2006.11369v1 Theorem 1.1; its known 2K2 obstruction, Theorem 1.3, is credited. Weber supplies a finite-window/tail/Gaussian mechanism precedent only: his independent-sum theorem and constants are not imported for dependent triangle counts. No novelty, firstness, new deep method, new local limit theorem, current worldwide openness or independent-discovery lineage is certified.
